text:
A person stands 1.0m in front of a plane mirror. The mirror is moved away from the person at a
speed of 1.0m/s.
Which statement is correct?
A
The image moves away from the person at a speed of 1.0m/s.
B
The image moves away from the person at a speed of 2.0m/s.
C
The image moves towards the person at a speed of 1.0m/s.
D
The image moves towards the person at a speed of 2.0m/s.

options.label: A
options.text: The image moves away from the person at a speed of 1.0m/s.

options.label: B
options.text: The image moves away from the person at a speed of 2.0m/s.

options.label: C
options.text: The image moves towards the person at a speed of 1.0m/s.

options.label: D
options.text: The image moves towards the person at a speed of 2.0m/s.
